system.description:
• Self-taught in the slums, where illusion is survival and misdirection is currency.
  • Distraction Work: Advantage on Pick Pocket and sleight of hand while an illusion distracts the target. Minor Figment also lets you move 10ft without provoking Attacks of Opportunity.
  • Street Smarts: Advantage on all Deception checks and on identifying confidence schemes, forgeries, or misdirection aimed at you.
